params.prompt: Full-body character design: a mounted fighter, one small rider on one animal. The mount is a sturdy soot-grey mountain ram with thick curled horns capped in polished brass, a shaggy chest, short strong legs and a patched red saddle blanket. The rider is a small, wiry courier in a short green coat, a leather satchel across the body, a striped scarf and round brass goggles, sitting upright in the saddle and holding a very long wooden lamplighter's pole level like a lance, tipped with a brass hook and a small steady flame. Three-quarter front view, the ram standing still on all four legs, the whole pole in frame. Chunky stylised proportions, clean readable shapes, hand-painted look, an original character for a stylised 3D video game set in a mountain forge town. Soft even studio lighting, plain light grey background, no text, no cast shadows.
